sources.title: Natural Earth Nile axes, canal axes and explicit salt pan references

access_metadata.source_date: 2022 release; observations composite, not a dated survey
access_metadata.geometry: Source River and Lake Centerline; Lake and Alkaline Lake polygons. Reservoir polygons excluded.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern generalised reference. River axes through regulated reaches are not reconstructed 1900 channels. Natural lake levels, deltas and banks may differ.
access_metadata.categories: River/lake-centreline axes; explicit Playa=salt pan/intermittent lake, not permanent water. Desert label polygons are not used as land cover.
access_metadata.historical_canals: Suez existed1869; modern generalized single axis is not a1900 bank or width survey.

sources.title: HydroRIVERS v1 Europe/Middle East and Africa clipped routed network
sources.publisher: WWF / HydroSHEDS; Bernhard Lehner and Günther Grill

access_metadata.sampling: Network extracted from15arcsec HydroSHEDS; coarser Hydro1k north of60N. No true river width.
access_metadata.source_epoch: SRTM mainly2000 plus composite ancillary/higher-latitude data; v1 modern reference, not1900
access_metadata.attribution: HydroRIVERS © WWF; Lehner B., Grill G.(2013), Global river hydrography and network routing, Hydrological Processes27:2171–2186; https://doi.org/10.1002/hyp.9740
access_metadata.distribution: Clipped/simplified derivatives integrated in WWO internal preview only; original regional shapefile excluded. Full licence retained with preview, no standalone redistribution.
access_metadata.required_attribution: This product WWO incorporates data from the HydroSHEDS version 1 database which is © World Wildlife Fund, Inc. (2006-2022) and has been used herein under license. WWF has not evaluated the data as altered and incorporated within WWO, and therefore gives no warranty regarding its accuracy, completeness, currency or suitability for any particular purpose. The HydroSHEDS v1 database and more information are available at https://www.hydrosheds.org.
access_metadata.water_regime: Not present in source: all routed network axes retain unknown regime and neutral dashed ink. No name, discharge or dry climate inference.

sources.title: HydroLAKES v1 selected named natural lakes and lagoons
sources.publisher: WWF / HydroSHEDS; Bernhard Lehner and Günther Grill

access_metadata.sampling: Composite approximately1:100000 to1:1million; source IDs and lake type retained
access_metadata.source_epoch: HydroLAKES2016 composite, predominantlySRTM/SWBD2000 and source maps; not1900
access_metadata.attribution: Messager M.L. et al.(2016), Estimating the volume and age of water stored in global lakes using a geo-statistical approach, Nature Communications7:13603, https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms13603
access_metadata.distribution: Selected clipped/simplified WWO derivatives; original global database retained in research, not packaged
